authorization: User requested preventing single-core Fabric rendering and asked for use of the server's 32 CPU threads.
classification: WL21A execution follow-up. Existing evidence and the original protocol are preserved.
upstream: Released Fabric scene1, native 8DNA model and weights, CUDA neuralpath integrator, depth10, rr5
implementation: Spawned processes, each with one native CUDA scene/model, rendering camera crops with reconstruction-filter overlap. The coordinator assembles tile interiors.
automatic_workers: Use the process CPU affinity count as the requested maximum. Calibrate a representative center tile. Admit workers according to measured free VRAM and per-process GPU memory.
headroom_role: Execution choices used by automatic mode. Explicit numeric --workers enables separately monitored scaling probes.
random_streams: Native method seedbase + 100000*rep + 1000000*tile_index + completed_spp. Fixed tile/chunk/rep configuration gives identical serial and parallel sample streams and supports spp extension.
cache: Per-tile float64 sum and first128 sum, atomically saved every32spp and at the requested target. Configuration identity checked on resume.
monitoring: Per-batch progress, coordinator reports every5s with ETA and CPU usage. A worker without progress for task-timeout is terminated with its process group, retaining committed tile caches.
performance_scope: Tiled execution has its own metadata and output directory. Report startup/calibration and rendering wall times explicitly.
full_queue: The previously stopped public-asset queue stays stopped. Bounded execution probes and one Fabric 128spp completion validate this change.
